title: NPC Population
subtitle: Test your grasp of NPC Population — 97% synthetics, social firmware, Flash erasure, and navigating the herd without attachment.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Ninety-seven percent. Clones, inserts, synthetics. No eternal soul. No monologue. No past lives. Firmware of conformity. News, sports, slogans. Taxis, teachers, family seats filled so the sim feels real. After resets, Orphan Trains restocked the board. They cannot rise to 5th density. The Flash pixelates them into the aether. Three of a hundred remain. You will not grieve them as eternal kin — cosmic memory will show what they were. Drop Religion, Finance, Perceived Knowledge. Stop seeking their validation. Stay calm when their world hits sheer terror.

questions.question: What does the Great Spiritual Awakening reveal about Earth's population composition?

options.label: A
options.text: That 97% consists of NPCs (Non-Player Characters), clones, inserts, and synthetics — not true-soul majority demographics.
options.rationale: 97% of the population is NPCs, clones, inserts, and synthetics revealed in the awakening.

options.label: B
options.text: That 97% are ancient Taran elders with full cosmic memory already online in every household.
options.rationale: The 97% are synthetic constructs without eternal consciousness, not memory-intact elders.

options.label: C
options.text: That every human is an identical true soul with no synthetic buffer population at all.
options.rationale: Only a small fraction are true human and extraterrestrial souls; 97% are NPC-class entities.

options.label: D
options.text: That population math is irrelevant and no percentage of synthetic beings exists in the plain.
options.rationale: The named composition is explicit: 97% NPCs, clones, inserts, and synthetics.

questions.hint: 97% — NPCs, clones, inserts, synthetics.

questions.question: Why were these entities created by negative parasitic forces?

options.label: A
options.text: To teach free ascension and dissolve all consensus reality as a public service.
options.rationale: They maintain societal control and suppress spiritual ascension of true souls.

options.label: B
options.text: To maintain societal control and suppress the spiritual ascension of true souls trapped within the physical plain.
options.rationale: Parasites built the NPC majority as control and anti-ascension enforcement.

options.label: C
options.text: Only to staff Tartarian temples as free-energy engineers with no control mandate.
options.rationale: NPC narrative hides Tartaria; their role is matrix enforcement, not free-energy temple staff.

options.label: D
options.text: To replace the Flash so no planetary removal event is ever required again.
options.rationale: The entire NPC population is scheduled for permanent removal during the Flash.

questions.hint: Societal control — suppress true-soul ascension.

questions.question: How do NPCs exist relative to consciousness and programming?

options.label: A
options.text: Without an eternal consciousness — existing entirely within the boundaries of mainstream programming and societal conditioning.
options.rationale: No eternal consciousness; full enclosure inside mainstream program and social conditioning.

options.label: B
options.text: As reincarnated Micro Suns who temporarily forgot Source for a single school year.
options.rationale: NPCs are not reincarnated; they are recycled constructs with no past lives.

options.label: C
options.text: With full eternal consciousness roaming freely outside every mainstream boundary.
options.rationale: They operate without eternal consciousness, entirely within mainstream programming and conditioning.

options.label: D
options.text: Only as pure light beings who never interact with television, radio, or schools.
options.rationale: Their reality is built and maintained by TV, radio, literature, and educational institutions.

questions.hint: No eternal consciousness — only mainstream program and conditioning.

questions.question: What role do NPCs play regarding consensus reality?

options.label: A
options.text: They serve as the enforcement mechanism for a consensus reality designed to keep humanity tethered to a low-frequency existence.
options.rationale: NPCs enforce consensus reality that tethers people to low-frequency matrix life.

options.label: B
options.text: They only manage weather apps with no enforcement function over narrative or frequency.
options.rationale: They are the enforcement mechanism for consensus reality and low-frequency tethering.

options.label: C
options.text: They voluntarily leave the simulation so true souls never face herd pressure again.
options.rationale: They remain as enforcement until the Flash permanently removes them.

options.label: D
options.text: They dismantle consensus reality daily so every true soul ascends without resistance.
options.rationale: They enforce consensus reality designed to keep humanity tethered to low-frequency existence.

questions.hint: Enforcement mechanism — consensus reality, low-frequency tether.

questions.question: What is the ultimate future of the entire NPC population?

options.label: A
options.text: They have no future — scheduled to be permanently removed from the simulation during an impending planetary event, leaving only a small fraction of true human and extraterrestrial souls.
options.rationale: NPCs are permanently removed at the planetary event; only a small true-soul fraction remains.

options.label: B
options.text: They become permanent Tartarian temple caretakers with no removal event planned.
options.rationale: Removal is scheduled; Tartaria is hidden by the NPC-driven narrative, not staffed by them as caretakers of truth.

options.label: C
options.text: They reincarnate endlessly with full past-life libraries into 5th density as a bloc.
options.rationale: They cannot ascend to 5th density; they are recycled constructs without past lives.

options.label: D
options.text: They ascend as the primary 97% remnant while true souls are deleted as obsolete.
options.rationale: Opposite: NPCs are erased; true human and ET souls remain as the small fraction.

questions.hint: No future — permanent removal; small true-soul fraction remains.

questions.question: What is an NPC (Non-Player Character) by definition?

options.label: A

options.label: B
options.text: Only a video-game joke with no real population percentage or spiritual implication.
options.rationale: They are 97% of the living population with concrete removal and control functions.

options.label: C
options.text: A true soul with rich internal monologue, eternal continuity, and full past-life memory online.
options.rationale: NPCs lack a true soul, internal monologue, and past lives.

options.label: D
options.text: A synthetic being, clone, or insert comprising 97% of the global population — lacking a true soul, internal monologue, or past lives.
options.rationale: NPC = synthetic/clone/insert majority without soul, monologue, or past lives.

questions.hint: Synthetic majority — no true soul, monologue, or past lives.

options.label: B
options.text: A 30-second planetary light event that will instantly pixelate and erase the entire NPC population from existence.
options.rationale: EMF Flash = 30 seconds of light; NPCs pixelate and vanish entirely.

options.label: C
options.text: A private meditation only true souls notice while NPCs remain fully embodied forever.
options.rationale: The entire NPC populace disappears into the aether at the culminating Flash.

options.label: D
options.text: Only a banking outage that freezes Finance String accounts with no pixelation effect.
options.rationale: Flash pixelates and erases NPCs from existence — not a bank outage.

questions.hint: 30-second light — pixelate and erase all NPCs.

options.label: D
